attributes.action: Protect parent and child parking bays nationwide
attributes.additional_details: These should include clear eligibility rules, consistent signage, regular checks and a simple way to report misuse. The Government should also consider a separate parent-and-child parking badge or permit, displayed when travelling with an eligible child, to help operators identify appropriate use.
attributes.background: I want the Government to introduce enforceable standards for parent-and-child parking bays in public and privately operated car parks. These should include regular checks and a simple way to report misuse The Government should also consider a separate parent-and-child parking badge or permit.

rejection.details:
